resolution.note: The one blocking finding (check_pedagogy §9, L139) rested on a claim that is false at module scope, and the judge never counted. It quoted the maintainer push-back row -- "the only beat paying the account-versus-actual-state LO" -- as a module-wide census. The row is a trimmed copy of Ex1s own watch-for at exercises/orient-and-introspect.md, which reads "the one beat HERE with no fence"; the scoping word was dropped in transit and the census reading is an artefact of that. Counted independently against the four inlined exercises, the LO is paid at least five times, three of them inside fences the student copy-pastes: orient-and-introspect-2 (produces the account), orient-and-introspect-3 (registry note verified verbatim: "pedagogical delta against read-self-report reveals the unread slice" -- instrument reading set against the agents narrative), close-the-ticket-2 (verified verbatim at line 20: "Separate strong signals, guesses that need more tickets, and things you cannot tell"), plus Ex2s diff push-back and Ex4s summary quote-back. Rule 9s Pass-2 check (n>=2 with contrast) passes several times over, and the proposed fix -- fold the check into Ex3s push-back -- is a no-op against a fence that already carries it. The transcription that caused the misread was cut rather than qualified. Filed against a maintainer block, not the body it describes.
